notes_translated.en: This dataset is a customization of Statistics Canada data to present information on labour force estimates by industry and by occupation (2, 3 and 4 digits) for Alberta and for the economic regions of Edmonton and Calgary from 2000 to 2013 using annual averages. The labour force characteristic presented on is employment.
